info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Market Order Cancellations API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Market Order Cancellations API enables users to efficiently cancel market orders within the wholesale trading sector. This endpoint accommodates users looking to manage their orders by allowing immediate cancellations, thereby enhancing transactional control. Typical consumers include traders and financial institutions engaged in high-frequency trading. This API supports a seamless integration into trading platforms and financial applications, ensuring quick response times and reliable order management.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a specific market order identified by its unique ID (RES-100045) within the wholesale trading system. Ensure that the order is eligible for cancellation before making this request.
